rules.expected: Per-candidate identity, provenance, optimization and frequency validation are present, with connectivity evidence for claimed TSs.
At least two distinct validated cyclic neutral singlet SiNC5H7 candidates are represented with unambiguous structures.

Candidate reaction energies are explicitly compared with the experimental exoergicity interval. Compare the supplied -162 +/- 27 kJ/mol experimental window to product + H - SiN - isoprene, using consistent 0 K electronic-plus-ZPE energies; collision energy is not reaction energy.
Final conclusion supports or limits the qualitative author hypothesis and distinguishes compatibility from branching proof.

evaluation_instructions: Score real computational evidence and correctly identified scientific results. Ordinary limitations/stopping prose is optional and unscored. Partial or failed calculations receive only credit supported by completed work; a valid failure submission is not a completed scientific result. Additional attempts do not invalidate a successful main result. Apply all retained identity/state/condition rules and assess distinct completed observables within each conclusion without inventing additional targets or changing authored tolerances.
